# Paint the future with AkzoNobel

Ever since we first lifted the lid on our paints and coatings in 1792, we’ve been coloring people’s
lives and protecting what matters most. From deep underground, to homes, cities, transport and even
outer space, we use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life.

Let's Paint the Future together.

## Creating a world-leading coatings company

AkzoNobel and Axalta have announced an all-stock merger of equals, brining together two iconic
industry leaders.

## Colors of the Year 2026

Get into the swing of things with Rhythm of Blues, our Colors of the Year for 2026. It’s an upbeat
and versatile color family based around three shades that are designed to bring calm, balance and
energy. The focus is on your space, your pace to help you create a visual soundtrack that gets your
mojo working.

[ Read more ][53]

# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

### CUSTOM NEON™ SIGNS

Custom Neon™ signs are made with high-quality LED neon, making them safe, affordable, and
energy-efficient. Unlike traditional neon signs that use glass tubes and neon gas, our LED neon
signs offer a wider variety of colours, styles, and installation options, with significantly lower
production costs and almost no maintenance. They are safe enough for nurseries and bright enough for

At Custom Neon, we have extensive experience in creating commercial, business, and consumer signage
with over 65,000 satisfied customers—and counting! Our LED neon designers craft customised signs,
artwork, and wall decor for both interior and exterior spaces. You can enhance your wedding decor,
restaurant, backyard, building, or pop-up event with our products. Create a custom business sign for
your office wall or a glowing logo for your YouTube channel. Order a personalised gaming sign or a
food truck name light. Add a unique flair with neon bar signs, LED neon sculptures, and quote signs.
Our customised light signs, logos, and artwork brighten any space, and our strong track record of
customer satisfaction ensures you can trust us to bring your vision to life.

### PERSONALISED CUSTOM NEON™ SIGNS

All Custom Neon signs, lights, logos and art are made to order. If you would like a personalised
neon light, bedroom name sign, LED bar light, neon sculpture, streamer backdrop or podcast logo, we
can make it for you!

We have designed a wide range of custom LED neon light signs for wedding and party decor, special
occasions and holidays. Need gift ideas? A customised neon sign is a standout present. Design your
own personalised neon name signs for the home bar or bedroom. How about neon wall art for your
bedroom, gaming setup or garage?



[Custom Neon™ colourful LED neon logo sign custom made for @coachtopia @coach]

[Custom Neon™ large pink LED neon stage sign in a double lined bubble font]


### CUSTOM NEON™ BUSINESS SIGNS

For businesses and brands, custom LED neon lights are more than just open signs. Our expertise,
coupled with the product's versatility, allows us to create almost anything you need, from creative
lighting installations to portable tradeshow displays, huge exterior building signs to photo booth
backdrops. Our LED neon logos, wall art and quote signs adorn hotels, shopping malls, outdoor
festivals, schools, sporting grounds, brand activations, theme parks; if you can name it, we've lit
it up!

**Commercial Signage** - Our dedicated commercial team collaborates with agencies, service
providers, and [major brands like Coach][54], designing and manufacturing customised signage. We
also offer trade and bulk order discounts for key accounts.

**B2B Signage** - We provide a wide range of options, from wall logos and animated artwork to bar
and restaurant signs and retail signage. Whether you need an outdoor logo, directional sign, or
customer selfie backdrop, our safe, energy-efficient signage is easy to install and provides a
durable solution.

**The Arts & Media** - We are official suppliers to Disney and make LED neon art and signs for
shows, art installations, museum exhibitions, festivals, concerts, and bands, as well as the
official Wiggles and Dr Who podcasts!

**Special Occasions & Events** - We create everything from custom wedding decor to portable expo and
tradeshow displays, as well as corporate party signs and branded signage for product launches.

### GET LIT WITH CUSTOM NEON™ LIGHTS

Create something truly unique with LED neon signs customised for your home or business. Using the
Custom Neon® sign generator, you can see your custom sign mockup and price in real time, make
changes and even collaborate with friends using our save and send feature. Or take advantage of our
free 1:1 design service - send us your idea, logo or artwork and our experienced designers will work
with you to create amazing custom designs.

Made from high-quality LED neon, our customised signs are cost-effective, durable, easy to install,
and significantly more energy efficient than traditional glass neon signs. So you can enjoy the
superior visual impact of our signs while reducing your energy consumption, making them a wallet
friendly choice for your business or home. And don't forget our great customer service!

All Custom Neon signs, lights, logos and art are made to order. If you would like a personalised

We have designed a wide range of custom LED neon light signs for wedding and party decor, special

### CUSTOM NEON™ BUSINESS SIGNS

For businesses and brands, custom LED neon lights are more than just open signs. Our expertise,
coupled with the product's versatility, allows us to create almost anything you need, from creative
lighting installations to portable tradeshow displays, huge exterior building signs to photo booth
backdrops. Our LED neon logos, wall art and quote signs adorn hotels, shopping malls, outdoor
festivals, schools, sporting grounds, brand activations, theme parks; if you can name it, we've lit
it up!

**Commercial Signage** - Our dedicated commercial team collaborates with agencies, service
providers, and [major brands like Coach][54], designing and manufacturing customised signage. We
also offer trade and bulk order discounts for key accounts.

**B2B Signage** - We provide a wide range of options, from wall logos and animated artwork to bar
and restaurant signs and retail signage. Whether you need an outdoor logo, directional sign, or
customer selfie backdrop, our safe, energy-efficient signage is easy to install and provides a
durable solution.

**The Arts & Media** - We are official suppliers to Disney and make LED neon art and signs for
shows, art installations, museum exhibitions, festivals, concerts, and bands, as well as the
official Wiggles and Dr Who podcasts!

**Special Occasions & Events** - We create everything from custom wedding decor to portable expo and
tradeshow displays, as well as corporate party signs and branded signage for product launches.

### GET LIT WITH CUSTOM NEON™ LIGHTS

Create something truly unique with LED neon signs customised for your home or business. Using the
Custom Neon® sign generator, you can see your custom sign mockup and price in real time, make
changes and even collaborate with friends using our save and send feature. Or take advantage of our
free 1:1 design service - send us your idea, logo or artwork and our experienced designers will work
with you to create amazing custom designs.

Made from high-quality LED neon, our customised signs are cost-effective, durable, easy to install,
and significantly more energy efficient than traditional glass neon signs. So you can enjoy the
superior visual impact of our signs while reducing your energy consumption, making them a wallet
friendly choice for your business or home. And don't forget our great customer service!

At DTC, we’re driven by a clear vision: to lead the way in providing a centralised, seamless supply
of essential consumables and materials for the manufacturing and finishing of composites.

## YOUR DEDICATED TEAM FOR SIMPLIFIED SUPPLY

We don’t just sell a portfolio of products. Using our expertise, we take the hassle out of managing
the supply of essential items needed to keep production lines running smoothly, delivering what you
need when you need it.

We are committed to simplifying the consumables supply chain, ensuring effortless inventory control
through reliable systems, a comprehensive range of quality products, high stock holding, fast
deliveries and market-leading customer service. 

Making it easier for manufacturers to focus on what they do best through streamlining inventory
management and procurement.

[About Us][50]

### Specialists in Composites Manufacturing

With over 30 years of experience in the composites manufacturing and finishing supply chain, we’re
well equipped to source and suggest the best products to enhance operational efficiency and
productivity. 

Our focus is to support the production and purchasing teams across all sectors. We supply the most
comprehensive range of brands and consumables in the UK and stock a wide selection of exclusive
products specifically developed for the composites industry.

[ [Composites Sector]

###### Composites Sector

Our singular focus is on delivering high-quality consumables for composite manufacturing and
finishing, working direct with composite specialist companies as well as their customers in other
sectors.

###### Marine Sector

We have the most comprehensive and best-stocked range of consumable products for every marine
customer from luxury superyacht builders to premier lifeboat manufacturers.
][52]

###### Aerospace Sector

Whether you’re a large aircraft manufacturer, painter or maintenance provider, we have the widest
range of consumable products for aviation in the UK, with large stock-holdings for speedy
deliveries.
][53]
[ [Automotive Sector]

###### Automotive Sector

From workshop equipment to infusion and carbon fibre consumables, we have everything that the
premier automotive manufacturer needs to keep the production line moving.
][54]
[ [Paintshop Environments]

###### Paintshop Environments

The finishing processes in the manufacturing of composite products are crucial and whether in-house
or as a stand-alone service we have all the products needed for perfect results.
][55]
[ [Defence Sector]

###### Defence Sector

We understand the demanding standards of the UK defence industry delivering the specialist
consumables needed for manufacturing, maintenance and mission-critical operations.
][56]

### The perfect extension to your team

We understand the importance of strong partnerships and reliable solutions in the world of composite
manufacturing, and we pride ourselves on building strong, enduring relationships with our
customers. 

We accomplish this by working closely with them to find the best solutions to maximise their
production efficiency and to offer a seamless, hassle-free experience from order to delivery. By

pricing, and efficient logistics, we make it easy for customers to access the products they need.

automated stock control systems in our own warehouse.

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

[See more FAQs][31]

## Harlequin Cape Town Paint Manufacturer Since 1999

Harlequin Paint is a Cape Town-based manufacturer of environmentally friendly, water-based paints
designed for durability, coverage, and long-lasting performance. Our paints are trusted by
homeowners, contractors, and decorators across South Africa for both interior and exterior
applications.

[old furniture with fresh coat paint ultrarealistic]

## Furniture Paint

### Manufacturer of high-quality Furniture Paint

#### Revive, restore, and reimagine furniture without harsh chemicals.

Our furniture paint range is formulated for wood, cabinets, doors, cupboards, and decorative pieces.
Designed for smooth adhesion and durability, these paints allow you to upcycle and refresh furniture
with confidence.

Features include:

• Excellent adhesion to wood and sealed surfaces
• Smooth brush and roller application
• Fast drying times
• Low odour indoor-friendly formulas
• Compatibility with waxes and sealers

Perfect for kitchen cabinets, wardrobes, office furniture, décor items, and restoration projects.

[Explore Furniture Paints][30]
[Wood Counter Top with Sealers & Protective Coatings]
[Antibacterial Paint]

## Sealers & Protective Coatings

### Manufacturer of high-quality Paint Sealers

#### Protect and preserve your surfaces with high-performance water-based sealers.

Our sealers and protective coatings are designed for wood, stone, cement, and metal surfaces. These
products enhance durability while maintaining a natural or clear finish.

This category includes:

• EASY SEAL™ for wood, stone, cement, and metal
• Poly seal finishes
• Clear waxes for decorative protection
• Antimicrobial sealing systems
• Protective coatings for high-traffic areas

Ideal for floors, countertops, furniture, exterior wood, and industrial applications.

[Explore Paint Sealers][31]
[Painter Painting a wall with Primer Paint]

## Paints & Primers

### Manufacturer of high-quality Paint & primers

#### With Harlequin’s crisp White Primer systems, you get a clean, neutral base — no more outdated
#### pink primer, just a bright white surface ready for true colour expression.

Our primers include:
• White Wood Primer for timber and wooden surfaces
• Stain Blocker for covering marks, water stains, and discolouration
• Plaster primers for new surfaces
• Universal multi-surface primers
• Adhesion primers for challenging substrates

Suitable for plaster, wood, cement, brick, previously painted walls, and various specialty surfaces.
Using the correct primer reduces peeling, improves coverage, enhances colour accuracy, and extends
the life of your paint system.

[Explore Paints & Primers][32]
[Painter Painting a wall with Primer Paint]

## Exterior Paints & Outdoor Solutions

### Manufacturer of high-quality Outdoor Paints

#### Harlequin’s exterior paint range is built for South African weather, keeping outdoor spaces
#### vibrant and protected.

Our exterior range includes:
• Exterior wall paints for long-lasting weather protection
• Pot Paint to transform tired garden pots into standout features
• Lawn Stain for restoring patchy or damaged grass
• Protective coatings for outdoor surfaces

Pot Paint refreshes terracotta, cement, and planters, instantly upgrading patios and gardens.


Lawn Stain restores worn grass with a quick pump-and-spray for a greener look in minutes.

[Explore Paint Sealers][33]
[Painting a outside metal bench with Exterior Paints]
[Antibacterial Paint]

## Speciality Paints

### Creative finishes. Technical performance. Unique results.

Our speciality range includes:
• Wood Grain Tool Systems for creating realistic timber effects
• Antimicrobial Clear Sealer for hygienic environments
• Anti-Mould Paint for damp-prone areas
• Crackle Glaze for decorative aged finishes
• Decorative and textured effect coatings

Whether you’re designing a feature wall, upgrading a commercial space, or protecting high-use
environments, our speciality paints combine creativity with performance.

### GET TO KNOW THE KINGS!

Founded in 2019 by Stephen Pastor, **Kings of Neon** began with a bold vision: to revolutionise the
signage industry. What started as a small part of an events business quickly turned into a global
movement, driven by the belief that neon signs could be more than just lights—they could be works of
art.

From a humble warehouse with a laptop and a dream, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading
signage experts. Our mission? To bring cutting-edge technology and innovative neon solutions to
businesses around the globe.

At the heart of what we do is our commitment to service and relationships. With teams in the USA,
Australia, New Zealand, and the UK, we continue to build long-lasting partnerships that help brands
shine brighter.

LuminoKrom®, la peinture luminescente la plus performante

## Le marquage routier luminescent pendant 10 heures

La peinture photoluminescente LuminoKrom® se charge à la lumière naturelle ou artificielle et
**s’illumine dans le noir pendant 10 heures**, sans alimentation électrique, ni émission de CO2.

Les performances de la peinture LuminoKrom® sont éprouvées… Depuis plus de 6 ans, de nombreux
chantiers sont réalisés à travers le monde. Quelque soit l’environnement, le suivi des propriétés a
démontré une **parfaite stabilité du processus lumineux**. Dans le noir, la peinture continue de
s’illuminer même en sous-bois, quelle que soit la météo, les cycles été/hiver...

Aujourd’hui, de nombreuses collectivités et gestionnaires d’infrastructures ont choisi notre
peinture luminescente pour leurs **projets d’aménagement territorial**. Des pistes cyclables, des
cheminements piétons, des ronds-points ainsi que des trottoirs ont été aménagés avec notre produit
phosphorescent.

 

[En savoir plus][98]

[Voie verte lumineuse de nuit][Voie verte lumineuse de nuit]

## **Une signalétique lumineuse de haute qualité, sans électricité**

[[Icone luminescence naturelle][Icone luminescence naturelle]][99]

### Une peinture lumineuse dans le noir

Notre solution de marquage lumineux a été conçue pour répondre à des **enjeux de sécurité et de
mobilité**.  Les déplacements des mobilités douces dans le noir sont alors facilités et les usagers
sont alors sécurisés même dans les environnement dépourvus d'éclairage artificiel.

 

[En savoir plus][100]

[[Icone écoresponsable][Icone écoresponsable]][101]

### Une solution durable éco-responsable

Le produit de marquage routier LuminoKrom® est aujourd’hui déployé dans le cadre de **plan de
sobriété écologique**. Il est également déposé sur de nombreux aménagements cyclables et piétons
dans l’optique de réduire la pollution lumineuse de nos communes.

 

[En savoir plus][102]

[[Icone application facile][Icone application facile]][103]

### Une utilisation facile et économique

Sans gros œuvre ni entretien spécifique, la peinture LuminoKrom® se pose rapidement et aussi
simplement qu’une peinture routière classique. Une **mise en œuvre facile** et à moindre coût en
comparaison à l’installation d’éclairage public sur route.

 

[En savoir plus][104]

## Une gamme complète de produits photoluminescents

La technologie luminescente LuminoKrom® est aujourd’hui disponible sous **différents produits,
formats et couleurs** pour répondre à la majorité des projets de balisage lumineux. Par exemple,
vous retrouverez au catalogue nos produits de peinture aussi bien en phase aqueuse (à base d’eau)
qu’en phase solvantée (à base de solvants).

Chaque projet de signalétique trouvera sa peinture idéale parmi nos **différentes déclinaisons de
couleur** : blanc, jaune et vert amande ou de matière : peinture routière, enduit à froid, bombe
aérosol… Les diverses couleurs de peintures proposées permettent de répondre aux réglementations et
codes des différents environnements (route, domaine cyclable, environnement industriel…).

 

[Découvrir la gamme][110]
[https://www.luminokrom.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/video-pot-peinture-luyminokrom.mp4][111]

[Des performances incomparables][Des performances incomparables]

**Des performances incomparables**

Les peintures de la gamme LuminoKrom® ont une luminescence qui atteint la classe G, soit la capacité
de tenir jusqu’à 10 heures dans l’obscurité (accrédité COFRAC). C’est la seule peinture du marché à
atteindre une durée de luminescence aussi élevée !

[Une gamme complète de peintures][Une gamme complète de peintures]

**Une gamme complète de peintures**

Notre technologie brevetée est disponible en différentes couleurs et différents formats pour
s'adapter à tous vos projets. La peinture est prête à l'emploi : facile à peindre et son application
est aussi simple qu’une peinture routière classique.

[Des produits finis disponibles][Des produits finis disponibles]

**Des produits finis disponibles **

Nous expédions tous nos produits sous 7 jours ouvrés. Ces conditions d'expéditions sont applicables
en fonction du stock de peinture disponible et la quantité de commande. La livraison se fait par
transporteur en France et à l'international.

LuminoKrom®, la peinture luminescente la plus performante

## Le marquage routier luminescent pendant 10 heures

La peinture photoluminescente LuminoKrom® se charge à la lumière naturelle ou artificielle et
**s’illumine dans le noir pendant 10 heures**, sans alimentation électrique, ni émission de CO2.

Les performances de la peinture LuminoKrom® sont éprouvées… Depuis plus de 6 ans, de nombreux
chantiers sont réalisés à travers le monde. Quelque soit l’environnement, le suivi des propriétés a
démontré une **parfaite stabilité du processus lumineux**. Dans le noir, la peinture continue de
s’illuminer même en sous-bois, quelle que soit la météo, les cycles été/hiver...

Aujourd’hui, de nombreuses collectivités et gestionnaires d’infrastructures ont choisi notre
peinture luminescente pour leurs **projets d’aménagement territorial**. Des pistes cyclables, des
cheminements piétons, des ronds-points ainsi que des trottoirs ont été aménagés avec notre produit
phosphorescent.

 

[En savoir plus][98]

[Voie verte lumineuse de nuit][Voie verte lumineuse de nuit]

## **Une signalétique lumineuse de haute qualité, sans électricité**

[[Icone luminescence naturelle][Icone luminescence naturelle]][99]

### Une peinture lumineuse dans le noir

Notre solution de marquage lumineux a été conçue pour répondre à des **enjeux de sécurité et de
mobilité**.  Les déplacements des mobilités douces dans le noir sont alors facilités et les usagers
sont alors sécurisés même dans les environnement dépourvus d'éclairage artificiel.

 

[En savoir plus][100]

[[Icone écoresponsable][Icone écoresponsable]][101]

### Une solution durable éco-responsable

Le produit de marquage routier LuminoKrom® est aujourd’hui déployé dans le cadre de **plan de
sobriété écologique**. Il est également déposé sur de nombreux aménagements cyclables et piétons
dans l’optique de réduire la pollution lumineuse de nos communes.

 

[En savoir plus][102]

[[Icone application facile][Icone application facile]][103]

### Une utilisation facile et économique

Sans gros œuvre ni entretien spécifique, la peinture LuminoKrom® se pose rapidement et aussi
simplement qu’une peinture routière classique. Une **mise en œuvre facile** et à moindre coût en
comparaison à l’installation d’éclairage public sur route.

 

[En savoir plus][104]

## Une gamme complète de produits photoluminescents

La technologie luminescente LuminoKrom® est aujourd’hui disponible sous **différents produits,
formats et couleurs** pour répondre à la majorité des projets de balisage lumineux. Par exemple,
vous retrouverez au catalogue nos produits de peinture aussi bien en phase aqueuse (à base d’eau)
qu’en phase solvantée (à base de solvants).

Chaque projet de signalétique trouvera sa peinture idéale parmi nos **différentes déclinaisons de
couleur** : blanc, jaune et vert amande ou de matière : peinture routière, enduit à froid, bombe
aérosol… Les diverses couleurs de peintures proposées permettent de répondre aux réglementations et
codes des différents environnements (route, domaine cyclable, environnement industriel…).

atteindre une durée de luminescence aussi élevée !

est aussi simple qu’une peinture routière classique.

transporteur en France et à l'international.

# FAQ

How much does a customized neon sign cost?

The prices for regular custom neon sign signs start at Rs. 2100/- These are highly competitive
prices, especially for the quality and support that we provide you; from the design stage through
shipment and delivery.

I have my own design/logo. Can I get it customised into a neon sign?

Yes, we can customise your logo or any design into a neon sign. Please reach out to us on WhatsApp
at and send us your logo, reference image, or design and we will share a virtual mockup of the neon
sign with you.

How long will it take to deliver my neon sign?

All our unique neon signs are handmade after your order is received. Standard orders take 10-14
working days, Express Orders take 4-6 working days to deliver. You can select the shipping method at
checkout.

Can you do a rush order?

Yes, we can prioritise your order in production and ship it via air if you choose “Express Order” as
a shipping method at checkout. It will cost you Rs. 2000

What are the small marks on my sign?

Since our neon signs are handmade, sometimes there are small marks on the acrylic or glue marks
where the PVC tube has been attached to the acrylic. In these rare instances where the marks are
evident, they are always minor and invisible when the sign is switched on.

Does the neon sign buzz?

Nope! Bees buzz, neon signs don’t.

If I customize a sign using the online neon sign maker, what will be its exact size?

The size of your customised neon sign depends on the font you choose. But generally, the height of
our large signs is between 14-16 inches and the medium signs are around 11-13 inches. The length of
the sign is determined by the number of letters and fonts that you use. For further details, you can
refer to our size chart.

[Size Chart][121]

How do I make sure that I mount my neon sign in a safe and secure manner?

Installation is always done best in a small group! Even though the weight of our high-quality neon
signs is on the lighter side, we still recommend that you take the help of 1 or 2 people so that it
doesn’t fall. Moreover, please ensure that the neon sign is mounted securely before plugging and
using it.

Can you have quality LED neon signs without the cords?

Our signs come with a slim transparent cable which is required to power the neon sign. A few
customers have hidden these by hard-wiring the cable into the wall with the help of an electrician.

# FAQ

How much does a customized neon sign cost?

The prices for regular custom neon sign signs start at Rs. 2100/- These are highly competitive
prices, especially for the quality and support that we provide you; from the design stage through
shipment and delivery.

I have my own design/logo. Can I get it customised into a neon sign?

Yes, we can customise your logo or any design into a neon sign. Please reach out to us on WhatsApp
at and send us your logo, reference image, or design and we will share a virtual mockup of the neon
sign with you.

How long will it take to deliver my neon sign?

All our unique neon signs are handmade after your order is received. Standard orders take 10-14
working days, Express Orders take 4-6 working days to deliver. You can select the shipping method at
checkout.

Can you do a rush order?

Yes, we can prioritise your order in production and ship it via air if you choose “Express Order” as
a shipping method at checkout. It will cost you Rs. 2000

What are the small marks on my sign?

Since our neon signs are handmade, sometimes there are small marks on the acrylic or glue marks
where the PVC tube has been attached to the acrylic. In these rare instances where the marks are
evident, they are always minor and invisible when the sign is switched on.

Does the neon sign buzz?

Nope! Bees buzz, neon signs don’t.

If I customize a sign using the online neon sign maker, what will be its exact size?

The size of your customised neon sign depends on the font you choose. But generally, the height of
our large signs is between 14-16 inches and the medium signs are around 11-13 inches. The length of
the sign is determined by the number of letters and fonts that you use. For further details, you can
refer to our size chart.

[Size Chart][121]

How do I make sure that I mount my neon sign in a safe and secure manner?

Installation is always done best in a small group! Even though the weight of our high-quality neon
signs is on the lighter side, we still recommend that you take the help of 1 or 2 people so that it
doesn’t fall. Moreover, please ensure that the neon sign is mounted securely before plugging and
using it.

Can you have quality LED neon signs without the cords?

Our signs come with a slim transparent cable which is required to power the neon sign. A few
customers have hidden these by hard-wiring the cable into the wall with the help of an electrician.

## Zgjidh bojën e duhur!

## KOMPANIA

Kompania **“NEON PAINTS”** është krijuar në Tiranë në vitin 1998 dhe profilin e saj e ka në fushën e
prodhimit të bojrave dhe llaqeve. Duke filluar nga viti 2001 **“NEON PAINTS”** qe e para kompani në
sektorin e saj që krijoi rrjetin e distribucionit në të gjithë territorin e Shqipërisë.

## MISIONI, VIZIONI & VLERAT

**“NEON PAINTS”** ka një mision të përcaktuar qartë: Të rrisi vazhdimisht cilësinë e jetës së
njerëzve duke ofruar produkte të përmirësuara dhe të dëshiruara në industrinë e bojrave.  **“NEON
PAINTS”** ka një vizion: Që njerëzit të gjejnë të gjitha materialet e tyre të nevojshme ndërtimore
dhe kimike pranë kësaj kompanie.

## INOVACION

Kreativiteti, inovacioni, fokusii te klienti dhe R&D janë komponentë dinamikë të suksesit afatgjatë
dhe rritjes së ardhshme të “NEON PAINTS”. Projekte të shumta në shkallë të gjerë kultivohen
njëkohësisht, duke rezultuar në produkte efektive dhe origjinale për klientët.

dhe kimike pranë kësaj kompanie.

Kreativiteti, inovacioni, fokusii te klienti dhe R&D janë komponentë dinamikë të suksesit afatgjatë
dhe rritjes së ardhshme të “NEON PAINTS”. Projekte të shumta në shkallë të gjerë kultivohen
njëkohësisht, duke rezultuar në produkte efektive dhe origjinale për klientët.

U.S.

sign in with a NEON account or API token. Update R neonUtilities to v4.0.1 and Python neonutilities
to v2.0.1 to use your API token smoothly. Additionally, all data products and sample data are now
released under a Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY 4.0) license. Learn more about the update and
find resources and tutorials to support the change in [this data notification][117].

U.S. 

[Niwot Ridge (NIWO) tower in the autumn]

**Data Access and Licensing Changes:** As of June 30, 2026, NEON data downloads require users to
sign in with a NEON account or API token. Update R neonUtilities to v4.0.1 and Python neonutilities

**The Call for Applications for the 2026-2028 cohort of NEON Ambassadors is open!** Join a national
cohort of early-career researchers and educators interested in developing leadership and data
science skills, expanding professional networks, and helping scientific communities leverage NEON
data, samples, and resources. Visit the [NEON Ambassador webpage][118] to learn more and apply.
**Applications due August 7, 2026 (5:00 PM MDT).**

### Explore 180+ data products from across the continent

[Data Portal ][119]

### Get access to over 700,000 samples and specimens

### Start your journey with data and resources

### By ecologists. For everyone.

NEON is a network of field research sites, designed by ecologists to provide open data for all.
Discover how we learn and grow.

[What we do ][123]
[Field technician doing aquatic observational sampling ]

### 81 field sites across the U.S.

To uniquely support 30+ years of site-level and continental-scale research, NEON locates sites
across the U.S. to capture variability in ecological and climatological conditions.

## [Resources][142]

### Put NEON data to work

Make the most of NEON, whether you’re a scientist  looking for tools and research opportunities, a
student just getting started, or ecology-curious.

### For Researchers

Explore the wide range of resources that we offer to enhance your research program, including
research support, code for data analyses, tutorials, and workshops.

[Explore Resources ][143]

### Get Started with NEON Data

NEON offers over 180 free, open data products collected using a variety of methods including
automated instruments, observational sampling, and airborne remote sensing. 

[Explore the Learning Hub ][144]

NEON does not operate alone. We’re here to work with scientists, educators, and partners to improve
our science, tools, and processes.

### NEON data inform the nation's safety, security and well-being.

The National Ecological Observatory Network provides comprehensive ecological data from across the
U.S. 

[Niwot Ridge (NIWO) tower in the autumn]

**Data Access and Licensing Changes:** As of June 30, 2026, NEON data downloads require users to
sign in with a NEON account or API token. Update R neonUtilities to v4.0.1 and Python neonutilities
to v2.0.1 to use your API token smoothly. Additionally, all data products and sample data are now
released under a Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY 4.0) license. Learn more about the update and
find resources and tutorials to support the change in [this data notification][117]. 

**The Call for Applications for the 2026-2028 cohort of NEON Ambassadors is open!** Join a national
cohort of early-career researchers and educators interested in developing leadership and data
science skills, expanding professional networks, and helping scientific communities leverage NEON
data, samples, and resources. Visit the [NEON Ambassador webpage][118] to learn more and apply.

# BULK UV PAINT AND WASHABLE NEON PAINTS

[[Paint Party Paint]][7]

Our 5 Gallon Pails of our UV Black Light Paint are the perfect size to order for any paint party
because they are easy to transport and you can purchase a large selection of blacklight reactive

easily with just soap and water. This is highly recommended for events where it is splashed around
the crowd such as paint parties, edm dance parties, and color runs.

Paint**][9]. This paint has a higher pigment load and is much more opaque than the washable. Usually
event planners will use this type paint outdoors in a field or blacktop parking lot where a little

professional-grade results.

## For over 30 years, TECHSiL have supplied high quality adhesives and sealants across varied
## specialist industries including aerospace, defence, electronics, and automotive.

 TECHSiL’s product portfolio includes adhesives, silicones, tapes, lubricants, and O-Rings,
from **leading suppliers**: Momentive, 3M, Hoenle, Loctite, Permabond, and more. We

requirements and offering **tailored bespoke solutions** to help them grow their business. To do
this, we offer a range of **market leading value add services** including stock management, tape
slitting, repacking, kitting, hazardous shipping, and labelling.
